bullets.text: Sports Development plans upgrades including a six-lane running track at Shenoy Nagar, hockey at Adyar, and football at Mandavelipakkam, and the office should monitor these facility rollouts.
Two dengue cases in Kattupakkam near Poonamallee caused public fear over delayed action, and the office should track health department vector control measures there.
Following media reports, the minister conducted a direct field inspection regarding the Gummidipoondi issue, and the office should follow up on the remedial actions.
Gummidipoondi was reported to have the highest air pollution in India, and the office should watch industrial pollution control steps in the SIPCOT estate.
Anna University campus placement job offers saw a twenty percent drop due to AI impact, and the office should watch employment trends for engineering graduates.
MeitY Secretary stated that AI regulation papers are in final stages and will be released shortly, and the office should review the policy framework upon release.
A theft of two crore rupees worth of server and ninety laptops occurred at a Guindy IT co-working office, and the office should track police recovery efforts.
DMK members protested against a TVK MLA by hanging an effigy upside down in a movie-style protest in Pattabiram and Avadi, and the office should watch local political tensions.
